summary: Security analysis of the `packaging` library revealed a High severity Eval Injection vulnerability in `src/packaging/licenses/__init__.py`, where `eval()` is used to process license expressions. This could potentially allow arbitrary code execution if the tokenizer is bypassed. Additionally, multiple Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) candidates were identified in core parsing modules (`version.py`, `specifiers.py`), which could impact the availability of tools relying on this package. Potential path traversal issues were also noted in platform compatibility modules.

/**
 * @name Subprocess usage
 * @description Finds calls to subprocess functions to check for command injection risks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to subprocess function."
findings.hypothesis: Potential command injection via subprocess usage.

/**
 * @name Command injection
 * @description Executing commands containing untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    exists(DataFlow::ParameterNode p | source = p)
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(SystemCommandExecution ce).getCommand()
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
